tracks.title: Choosing picture cards in class

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: きょうは、えのカードをみます。
turns.english: Today we're going to look at picture cards.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: どのカードをみますか。
turns.english: Which card will you look at?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: ねこのカードをみます。
turns.english: I'll look at the cat card.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いぬのカードもありますよ。

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: では、いぬのカードもみます。
turns.english: Then I'll look at the dog card too.

tracks.title: Reading a nature book at the library

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: このほんは、やまのほんです。
turns.english: This is a book about mountains.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: そらのえもありますか。
turns.english: Are there pictures of the sky too?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい。そらとかわのえがあります。
turns.english: Yes. There are pictures of the sky and a river.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: ありがとうございます。ここでよみます。
turns.english: Thank you. I'll read it here.

comprehensionPrompts: What two things are pictured in the book?
